clue.text: Scorn shown for cheat with allure

parts.note: to con someone is to cheat or swindle them
to allure is to tempt or entice

explanation.surface: Someone's charm hides a swindle, and the onlooker shows disdain.
explanation.definitionFit: Contempt is the feeling of disdain that scorn expresses; the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Checks fraud within the Civil Service

indicators.note: within says one piece sits inside the other, here the fraud inside the service

parts.note: CS is the standard abbreviation for the Civil Service
a ramp is British slang for a swindle or racket

explanation.surface: Audits uncover a swindle inside a government department.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Checks' is a verb meaning restrains, not a noun for inspections.
explanation.definitionFit: To cramp someone is to restrict or hold them back, as checks do.

clue.text: Against retirement before the age required in Italy

indicators.note: retirement suggests going backwards, so the word for against is read in reverse

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
an era is an age

explanation.surface: Opposition to raising the retirement age in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: CON (against) turned back gives NOC, then ERA (age). Nocera is a town in central Italy known for its bottled mineral water.
explanation.definitionFit: Nocera Umbra mineral water is a staple ordered with meals across Italy.

clue.text: Wearing down the rat from the Orient?

parts.note: the Orient is the East, abbreviated E
a rat is a rodent

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about a rat from the Far East.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the fanciful image of an eastern rodent.
explanation.definitionFit: Erodent is an adjective for something that erodes, gradually wearing a surface away.

clue.text: Sanctimonious newspaper leader: "white and black together"

parts.note: pi is British slang for pious or sanctimonious
the editor heads a newspaper, abbreviated ED

explanation.surface: A self-righteous editorial mocks seeing everything in black and white.
explanation.definitionFit: Pied describes animals or birds with patches of two colours, typically black and white, like a magpie.

clue.text: Such an angelic being makes many a man chafe

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, which crosswords read as many
he is a pronoun for a man
to chafe is to rub

explanation.surface: Something about a heavenly creature makes plenty of men irritated.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherub is a winged child angel in art and scripture.

clue.text: Growing integrity

definitions.meaning: a garden plant with papery seed pods, so something growing

explanation.definitionFit: Honesty is both a flowering plant (Lunaria) and the quality of being truthful and upright.

clue.text: Changing to richer and quite flowery language

indicators.note: changing tells us the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Turning up the vocabulary makes speech more ornate.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhetoric often means showy, ornate speech intended to impress.

clue.text: Teasing will be abandoned in time

parts.note: abandoned can mean wicked or depraved, so bad
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone warns that mockery will be dropped in due course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Abandoned' here means dissolute, hence BAD, not deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is playful banter, light teasing talk.

clue.text: Solitary worker going about a routine task

indicators.note: going about says the first piece wraps round the second

parts.note: the ant is the classic crossword worker
a chore is a routine task

explanation.surface: A labourer busy with daily drudgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solitary' is a noun here, a recluse, not an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchoret is a religious recluse living alone, a hermit.

clue.text: Mean though popular minister

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
to minister to someone is to tend them

explanation.surface: A cleric who is liked yet stingy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minister' looks like a noun (a cleric) but is the verb, to tend.
explanation.definitionFit: To intend something is to mean to do it.

clue.text: Won't tolerate the maltreatment of sisters

indicators.note: maltreatment means rough handling, so the letters of the word are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to stand for siblings being abused.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to oppose or refuse to accept something.

clue.text: The fellow who will bear anything for a drink

definitions.text: The fellow who will bear anything
definitions.meaning: a man employed to carry luggage or loads
a dark beer brewed from roasted malt

explanation.definitionFit: A porter both carries loads for others and is a dark heavy beer like stout.

clue.text: A poet's upset over this stirring article

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so these letters are turned into a new order

parts.note: on can mean over, as in on top of

explanation.surface: A versifier is distressed by something exciting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' rearranges A POETS before the piece for 'over' follows. 'Stirring' looks like exciting but means used for stirring tea.
explanation.definitionFit: A teaspoon is the small utensil used to stir a cup of tea.

clue.text: Take the second-class road with little hesitation -—it's wider

parts.note: B denotes second class or grade
er is the small noise made when hesitating

explanation.surface: Advice to take the minor road without dithering, since it has more room.
explanation.definitionFit: Broader is the comparative of broad, meaning wider.

clue.text: A woman's never-ending round!

parts.note: reads as a housewife's endless cycle of chores, but means a band given to a woman symbolising everlasting love

explanation.surface: A lament that a woman's work is never done.
explanation.definitionFit: An eternity ring is a band set with stones all the way round, symbolising endless love.

clue.text: Produce notes about indifferent rating

indicators.note: about says the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: to sing is to produce musical notes
cold means unfeeling or indifferent

explanation.surface: A singer delivers a lukewarm review.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rating' is the noun for a telling-off, not a score or rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A rating, in the old sense, is a sharp reprimand or scolding.

clue.text: The governor who decided in advance which party he'd support?

definitions.text: The governor who decided in advance which party he'd support?

parts.words: The governor who decided in advance which party he'd support?
parts.note: read as ..., one who chose a side beforehand, though the word means one who chairs a meeting

explanation.surface: A politician who picked his allegiance before the vote.
explanation.definitionFit: A presider is the person who presides over or governs a meeting.

clue.text: The return journey

parts.note: reads as a trip home, but means a trip that comes back to where it began by another way

explanation.surface: Coming home from a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A circular tour is a trip that ends at its starting point, so it returns.

clue.text: To reduce consumption is ineffective

parts.note: use is consumption
less means reduced or to a smaller degree

explanation.surface: Cutting back on consumption doesn't work.
explanation.walkthrough: To reduce consumption is to use less.
explanation.definitionFit: Something useless has no effect or value.

clue.text: Oblivious of a certain hostility in a French female

indicators.note: in places the hostility inside the French word

parts.note: une is the French indefinite article in its feminine form
war is open hostility

explanation.surface: A Frenchwoman unaware of a particular conflict.
explanation.walkthrough: The French feminine article is the container; 'female' points to its gender.
explanation.definitionFit: To be unaware is to be ignorant of something, oblivious to it.

clue.text: Ruthless but judicious — retaining a five

indicators.note: retaining means holding within, so one piece sits inside another

parts.note: sage means wise or judicious
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: A hard leader who is nevertheless wise in keeping a small team.
explanation.definitionFit: Savage means fierce and brutal, without mercy.

clue.text: Anything but old-fashioned about cash

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a cent is a coin, a piece of cash

explanation.surface: A modern attitude to money.
explanation.definitionFit: Recent means new and modern, the reverse of dated.

clue.text: Cut that may well be needless

indicators.note: says the letters of the word may be turned into something else

explanation.surface: A reduction that was probably unnecessary.
explanation.definitionFit: Lessened means reduced or cut down.

clue.text: Station outside a royal residence

indicators.note: outside says the station wraps round the A

parts.note: a station is a place or position

explanation.surface: A railway stop beside a monarch's home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Station' suggests a train stop; it means a position, PLACE, around A.
explanation.definitionFit: A palace is the official residence of a sovereign.

clue.text: Drinks dispenser in the bed-and-breakfast hotel

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A bar server at a B&B hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits inside 'tHE BEd'. Hebe was the cupbearer of the Greek gods.
explanation.definitionFit: Hebe was cupbearer to the Olympian gods, serving them nectar.

clue.text: Into action without any doubts at all

parts.note: into supplies in, the to merely joining it to the action
a deed is an action

explanation.surface: Throwing oneself into action with complete certainty.
explanation.definitionFit: Indeed is an emphatic word meaning truly, certainly.

clue.text: Brought back to conscious state

indicators.note: back says the word for brought is read in reverse

parts.note: led means brought or guided
aware means conscious

explanation.surface: Someone revived, brought round to consciousness.
explanation.walkthrough: LED turned back gives DEL. 'State' looks like a condition but is a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Delaware is a US state, the first to ratify the Constitution.

clue.text: The, new rig has to be flamboyant

indicators.note: new tells us the letters are formed into something new

explanation.surface: A fresh outfit has to be showy.
explanation.definitionFit: Garish means gaudy and showy, loudly flamboyant.

clue.text: Respectful, so constantly called on to fill the breach

indicators.note: to fill means one piece goes inside another

parts.note: a rent is a tear or breach
ever means always, constantly

explanation.surface: A dutiful person always summoned to plug the gap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breach' suggests battle, but here it is just a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverent means feeling or showing deep respect.
